svg.aria-label: A piano keyboard from B3 to C5: 9 white keys (B3, C4, D4, E4, F4, G4, A4, B4, C5) and 5 black keys in a group of two and a group of three. No notes are marked.
svg.title: The Week 2 keyboard window, B3 to C5

g.text: Nine white keys, from B3 to C5
B3 is the white key just left of C4. The
numbers above the black keys count each
How to read this graphic: Find C4, the white
key just left of the group of two black keys
in the middle of this window. B3 is the white
key immediately to its left. The small
numbers above the black keys count each group
(two, then three). Every white key carries
its octave number, so C4 and C5 are different
